overview.zh: Boston Dynamics 1992 年由 MIT Leg Lab 衍生创立，公开历史从 BigDog、早期 Atlas 等研究平台演进到 Spot、Stretch 和电动 Atlas。现行产品必须与历史液压 Atlas、实验演示和退役平台分开建档。
overview.en: Boston Dynamics was founded in 1992 as a spinout of the MIT Leg Lab. Its public history progresses from research platforms such as BigDog and early Atlas to Spot, Stretch, and electric Atlas; current products must be separated from historical hydraulic Atlas, demonstrations, and retired platforms.

overview.zh: 本次从本体扩展至Spot充电坞、电池、充电器、平板与运输套装，并保留Atlas、Stretch、Spot Arm和Orbit。支持页与2024 Spot PDF的质量、负载和感知距离存在不同口径，不能直接作为同一硬件版本的统一规格。 现补现行CAM 2、支持中的CAM+/CAM+IR、CORE I/O和EAP 2具名配置、GXP及套件/附件；合作方器件单列集成归属。
overview.en: Coverage expands from base robots to Spot dock, battery, charger, tablet and travel kits while retaining Atlas, Stretch, Spot Arm and Orbit. Current support-page and 2024 PDF mass, payload and sensing figures differ and are not a unified specification for one hardware revision. Current expansion covers CAM 2, supported CAM+/CAM+IR, named CORE I/O/EAP2 configurations, GXP and kits/accessories, with partner components separately attributed.

overview.zh: Boston Dynamics属于Hyundai集团控制的机器人业务。母公司规模、收购估值或投资不能替代本公司逐期收入和盈利；本次未完成韩国法定披露中子公司财务数据的逐表核对。
overview.en: Boston Dynamics is a Hyundai-controlled robotics business. Parent scale, acquisition valuation and investment are not substitutes for company revenue/profit; subsidiary tables in Korean statutory filings have not been fully reconciled in this pass.

products: Spot Industrial Inspection Package (CAM+IR support catalog)

overview.zh: Agility Robotics 2015 年源自俄勒冈州立大学 Dynamic Robotics Laboratory。公司从 Cassie 与早期研究版 Digit 演进到面向工业客户的 Digit，并用 Arc 管理任务、机群和企业系统连接。
overview.en: Agility Robotics was founded in 2015 from Oregon State University's Dynamic Robotics Laboratory. It evolved from Cassie and early research editions of Digit to an industrial Digit platform, with Arc handling tasks, fleets, and enterprise-system connectivity.

overview.zh: Digit与Arc分别承担机器人执行和云端工作流/机群编排。当前解决方案页的35 lb、4 h没有明确标成v5；本次不把它们跨代继承为v5额定值。公司时间线把Digit V1列在2017年，而独立发布归档日期是2019-02-19，需保留这项历史来源冲突。
overview.en: Digit performs physical work while Arc orchestrates cloud workflows and fleets. The current 35 lb and 4 h figures are not explicitly tagged v5 and are not inherited as v5 ratings. The company timeline places Digit V1 in 2017, while the independent launch archive is dated 2019-02-19; that historical conflict remains explicit.

overview.zh: 2026-06-24公告拟与Churchill Capital Corp XI合并，交易前股权估值25亿美元、预期总募资超过6.2亿美元；均受成交、赎回及其他条件限制。超过3亿美元多年度v5订单亦受合同里程碑限制，不是已确认收入。
overview.en: The 2026-06-24 proposed Churchill Capital Corp XI combination states a $2.5 billion pre-money equity value and expected gross proceeds above $620 million, subject to closing, redemptions and other conditions. More than $300 million of multi-year v5 orders are milestone-dependent, not recognized revenue.

overview.zh: 2026-10-18 补充：Digit 5 公布的规格仍为预生产估计，2027 年供应为计划；不能用早代现场部署或旧简介的“当前商业产品”措辞证明本代已交付。发布稿中超过 65000 h 的多客户运行，以及 GXO 累计 100000 个料箱、作业时约 98% 准确率，明确属于 Digit 4 的公司自述，不是 Digit 5 验证成绩、寿命或通用精度。来源：https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/agility-unveils-digit-5-humanoid-robot-built-for-cooperatively-safe-work-at-scale
overview.en: 2026-10-18 update: Digit 5 specifications remain pre-production estimates and 2027 availability is planned; earlier field deployments or retained current-commercial-product wording do not prove this generation has shipped. The release attributes more than 65000 h across customer sites and GXO's cumulative 100000 totes with approximately 98% on-task accuracy to Digit 4, as company-reported results, not Digit 5 validation, life or universal accuracy. Source: https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/agility-unveils-digit-5-humanoid-robot-built-for-cooperatively-safe-work-at-scale

overview.zh: 公司分工的公开描述为 Salem RoboFab 装配、Pittsburgh 工程测试/验证/技能开发，以及 2026-07 开放的 Fremont AI 开发设施。2023 年工厂公告称可扩展至每年超过 10000 台，2026 年发布稿改述满产设计为最高 10000 台；两者均非实际年产量。来源：https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/opening-robofab-worlds-first-factory-for-humanoid-robots；https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/agility-unveils-digit-5-humanoid-robot-built-for-cooperatively-safe-work-at-scale；https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/agility-opens-new-fremont-facility-to-accelerate-physical-ai-development
overview.en: Published site roles are Salem RoboFab assembly, Pittsburgh engineering test/validation/skill development, and the Fremont AI facility opened in 2026-07. The 2023 factory announcement says scalable beyond 10000 robots per year, while the 2026 release states design capacity up to 10000 at full scale; neither is actual annual output. Sources: https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/opening-robofab-worlds-first-factory-for-humanoid-robots; https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/agility-unveils-digit-5-humanoid-robot-built-for-cooperatively-safe-work-at-scale; https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/agility-opens-new-fremont-facility-to-accelerate-physical-ai-development

catalogScope.zh: 已复核所列现行目录；本组2条，全部保留已接收145个身份和2251字段。现行未入库身份、非SKU/第三方关系和参数缺口分别见审阅记录；不声称全部完成。 2026-10-18 本轮仅补充 Digit 5 预生产公告、FORT/Nyobolt 集成边界、Arc 技术说明和 6 个有来源历史节点；保留全部 156 身份与此前 4322 行。无新增制造商/附件身份，仍缺验收手册与完整工程表。
catalogScope.en: Reviewed listed current catalogs; 2 company records with all145 accepted identities and2251fields preserved globally. Current unregistered identities, non-SKU/third-party relationships and parameter gaps are separately reviewed; no exhaustive-completion claim. 2026-10-18 pass adds only Digit 5 pre-production announcements, FORT/Nyobolt integration boundaries, Arc technical details and 6 sourced history events; all 156 identities and prior 4322 rows retained. No manufacturer/accessory identity added; acceptance manuals and complete engineering tables remain missing.

detail.zh: 宣布与Churchill XI签署拟议交易；本次未核实交割完成。
detail.en: Announced a proposed Churchill XI transaction; closing was not verified in this pass.

detail.zh: 公告位于 Salem 的 70000 平方英尺工厂拟于当年稍后开放，初期建设始于 2022 年；规划首年数百台并扩展至每年超过 10000 台，满产超过 500 名员工。均是当时规划，不是当前产量/人数或当天开工投产证明。
detail.en: Announced a 70000-square-foot Salem factory intended to open later that year, with initial construction in 2022. Planned hundreds of robots in the first year, scaling beyond 10000 per year and more than 500 workers at full capacity; these are historical plans, not current output/headcount or proof of opening that day.

detail.zh: 继 2023 年末概念验证后，公布多年 RaaS 协议，在 SPANX 设施部署 Digit 与 Arc，连接 AMR 并执行料箱至输送机任务；不把这一历史现场认定为 Digit 5。
detail.en: Following a late-2023 proof of concept, announced a multi-year RaaS agreement deploying Digit and Arc at a SPANX facility, connecting AMRs and moving totes to conveyors; this historical installation is not identified as Digit 5.

title.zh: Fremont 实体 AI 设施开放公告

detail.zh: 60000 平方英尺设施用于 AI 技能训练、测试和开发；近 200 人招聘为计划。正文日期为 2026-07-16、页面发布日期为 2026-07-17，按月份入历程并保留差异。
detail.en: A 60000-square-foot facility for AI skill training, testing and development; nearly 200 hires are planned. Body dateline is 2026-07-16 while page publication is 2026-07-17; timeline uses the month and retains the distinction.

detail.zh: 发布新一代预生产设计及初步规格；早期访问预计 2027 上半年、普遍供应预计 2027 年底，不将发布日当作交付日。
detail.en: Unveiled a new pre-production design and preliminary specifications; early access expected in the first half of 2027 and general availability by the end of 2027, not delivery on the announcement date.

title.zh: FORT 安全合作谅解备忘录

detail.zh: 公布 FORT 合作谅解备忘录，拟将手持终端、本体通信与外部安全接口结合用于 Digit 5；不是所有安全功能已完成认证。
detail.en: Announced a FORT partnership memorandum to combine pendant, on-robot communications and external safety interfaces for Digit 5; not proof of completed certification for all safety functions.

title.zh: 选择 Nyobolt 电池技术

detail.zh: 公布 Digit 5 电池技术提供方为 Nyobolt；配备该技术的早期访问预计 2027 上半年，随后 6–9 个月增加供应，不是自制电池型号或已交付声明。
detail.en: Announced Nyobolt as Digit 5 battery technology provider; early access with it expected in the first half of 2027 and availability increasing over the next 6–9 months, not an in-house battery model or a delivered-product claim.

More than $300 million of multi-year v5 orders are milestone-dependent, not recognized revenue.

overview.zh: Figure 由 Brett Adcock 于 2022 年创立，公开路线从 Figure 01、Figure 02 演进到 Figure 03。公司页面将 01 定位为起点、02 定位为劳动力部署代际、03 定位为兼顾家庭与商业场景的现行代际。
overview.en: Figure was founded by Brett Adcock in 2022 and has publicly progressed from Figure 01 and Figure 02 to Figure 03. Its company page frames 01 as the beginning, 02 as the workforce generation, and 03 as the current generation spanning home and commercial settings.

overview.zh: 当前产品与软件覆盖Figure 03、Helix 02和Index数据采集平台。Index的下载、贡献者、视频与支出统计是2026-08-25公告时点的数据管线指标，不是机器人自由度、产量、收入或通用成功率。
overview.en: Current hardware/software coverage includes Figure 03, Helix 02 and the Index data-collection platform. Index downloads, contributors, videos and spending are pipeline metrics at 2026-08-25, not robot DoF, production, revenue or universal task-success rates.

overview.en: The 2025-09-16 Series C disclosure reports over $1 billion of committed capital at a $39 billion post-money valuation; commitment, cash receipt, spending and revenue differ. Index also announces a future twelve-month data/compute commitment above $1 billion.

overview.zh: Apptronik 2016 年由得州大学奥斯汀分校 Human Centered Robotics Lab 团队创立。公司称 Apollo 汇集此前 15 台机器人平台的经验；本仓把 2023 年首代 Apollo 与当前 Apollo 2 分开，避免代际参数串用。
overview.en: Apptronik was founded in 2016 by a team from the University of Texas at Austin Human Centered Robotics Lab. The company says Apollo builds on 15 earlier platforms; this repository separates the 2023 Apollo from Apollo 2 to prevent cross-generation specification mixing.

overview.zh: Apollo 2、2023版Apollo、Artemis控制软件和Fleet Connect运营软件分别建档。Apollo 2提供轮式/双足形态及电池、交互、安全能力描述，但没有完整型号数值表；不能用2023版的身高、质量和负载填补新代际。
overview.en: Apollo 2, Apollo 2023, Artemis control software and Fleet Connect operations software remain distinct. Apollo 2 describes wheeled/bipedal forms, batteries, interaction and safety, but no complete numerical model table; 2023 height, mass and payload cannot fill that gap.

overview.zh: 2026-02-11披露新增5.2亿美元A-X轮，接续2025年4.15亿美元A轮，总A轮超过9.35亿美元，累计融资接近10亿美元。估值为前轮的3倍只说明相对变化，未披露绝对估值。
overview.en: On 2026-02-11 Apptronik disclosed a $520 million A-X extension following a $415 million 2025 Series A, taking Series A above $935 million and total capital near $1 billion. A threefold valuation multiple does not disclose an absolute valuation.

overview.zh: 1X 于 2014 年以 Halodi Robotics 名义在挪威创立，2023 年更名为 1X。公司当前把美国帕洛阿尔托列为基地，并在挪威建设机器人与执行器制造能力。
overview.en: 1X was founded in Norway in 2014 as Halodi Robotics and adopted the 1X name in 2023. The company now identifies Palo Alto as its base while building robot and actuator manufacturing capacity in Norway.

overview.zh: NEO家用本体、2026年25自由度手部、EVE Industrial及Redwood分别保存。Redwood公开了160M参数、约5 Hz机载控制和机外语音处理；NEO的2025发布稿22自由度手部与2026新手部不属于同一规格版本。
overview.en: NEO home robot, the 2026 25-DoF hand, EVE Industrial and Redwood remain distinct. Redwood publishes 160M parameters, approximately 5 Hz onboard control and offboard speech processing. The 2025 launch hand at 22 DoF and the 2026 hand are different revisions.

overview.zh: 官方现行页面标2024-01-13，披露B轮1亿美元及一笔老股交易；旧发布镜像标1月11日。这里按月份记录，不把二级交易再次算作新增融资，也不采纳未得到官方确认的新一轮估值传闻。
overview.en: The current official page is dated 2024-01-13 and reports a $100 million Series B plus a secondary transaction; an older release mirror says January 11. This group records the month and does not double-count secondary trades or adopt unconfirmed later valuation rumors.

detail.zh: 披露B轮1亿美元；公告同时描述老股交易，融资与老股需分开。
detail.en: Disclosed $100 million Series B; the accompanying secondary transaction is distinct.

detail.zh: 发布25自由度腱驱手部；与2025发布稿22自由度版本区分。
detail.en: Introduced the 25-DoF tendon-driven hand, distinct from the 2025 22-DoF launch specification.

detail.zh: 公司成立具身世界模型研究团队；不登记成硬件产品。
detail.en: Company establishes embodied world-model research organization; not a hardware product.

investors.zh: EQT Ventures; Samsung NEXT; Skagerak Capital; Nistad group; Sandwater secondary participation
investors.en: EQT Ventures; Samsung NEXT; Skagerak Capital; Nistad group; Sandwater secondary participation

investmentView.en: The current official page is dated 2024-01-13 and reports a $100 million Series B plus a secondary transaction; an older release mirror says January 11. This group records the month and does not double-count secondary trades or adopt unconfirmed later valuation rumors.

overview.zh: Sanctuary AI 2018 年成立于温哥华，法律实体为 Sanctuary Cognitive Systems Corporation。公司公开路线把 Carbon 认知/控制软件、Phoenix 通用机器人和灵巧手作为相互关联但不同的资产。
overview.en: Sanctuary AI was founded in Vancouver in 2018 under the legal entity Sanctuary Cognitive Systems Corporation. Its public roadmap treats the Carbon cognitive/control software, Phoenix general-purpose robot, and dexterous hands as related but distinct assets.

overview.zh: 产品关系分为Phoenix数据采集本体、Carbon/Physical AI、17自由度液压手和触觉传感研发。2026手部页面说明试点即将开展，不能视为全面量产。汽车线束插接的99.5%以上成功率和2.54秒节拍仅属于所述任务与测试条件。
overview.en: The portfolio separates Phoenix data-capture hardware, Carbon/Physical AI, the 17-DoF hydraulic hand and tactile-sensor development. The 2026 hand page describes upcoming pilots, not broad volume production. More than 99.5% success and 2.54-second cycle time apply only to the stated wire-harness task and conditions.

overview.zh: 公司公开历史含融资及政府支持，但本次重点复核产品里程碑和工业订单，不把采购订单、试点或政府贡献与股权融资混算；未完成所有战略投资条款及法定财务报表检索。
overview.en: Public history includes financing and government support; this pass emphasizes product milestones and industrial orders. Purchase orders, pilots and government contributions are not combined with equity financing; strategic-investment terms and statutory accounts remain incompletely reviewed.

overview.zh: PAL Robotics 于 2004 年在巴塞罗那成立，法律主体为 PAL ROBOTICS, S.L.。公司时间线记录了从早期人形机器人到 TIAGo、TALOS、Kangaroo 和后续平台的演进。
overview.en: PAL Robotics was founded in Barcelona in 2004 and operates as PAL ROBOTICS, S.L. Its timeline records development from early humanoids through TIAGo, TALOS, Kangaroo, and later platforms.

overview.zh: 本次把原有TALOS单型号覆盖扩展至TIAGo、Lite、++、Pro、多个底盘、StockBot、KANGAROO模块平台、官方KANGAROO PRO三列表配置、末端和附件，以及Legacy目录中的TIAGo Head和REEM-C。套件、选件和本体分别表达，不生成官方没有提供的组合型号。 ARI现行链接的5页规格与升级表已逐块摘录；充电、对接和运输附件不从主机参数推算。
overview.en: Coverage expands from TALOS to TIAGo, Lite, ++, Pro, mobile bases, StockBot, modular KANGAROO, three official KANGAROO PRO table configurations, end effectors/accessories, and legacy TIAGo Head/REEM-C. Kits, options and base robots remain distinct without inventing combinations. ARI current five-page linked specification and upgrade blocks transcribed; charging, docking and transport accessories do not inherit invented ratings from the robot.

overview.zh: 本次未找到可直接对应PAL ROBOTICS, S.L.的完整公开定期报表集，也未核实最新股权融资金额。商业订单、欧盟研究项目与投资轮不可等同。
overview.en: This pass did not locate a complete freely accessible periodic-report set for PAL ROBOTICS, S.L. or verify a latest equity-round amount. Commercial orders, EU research projects and investment rounds are different categories.

overview.zh: TIAGo 单臂手册公开了 Hey5 欠驱动手、双电机平行夹爪及末端相机的集成方式，含 ROS 轨迹/电流限制接口与安装件。手册同时保留停售第三方末端的兼容记录，不能把兼容名单当作 PAL 自产或现售清单。
overview.en: The TIAGo single-arm handbook documents the underactuated Hey5 hand, two-motor parallel gripper and end-effector camera, including ROS trajectory/current-limit interfaces and mounting hardware. It also retains compatibility entries for discontinued third-party end effectors; these are not a PAL-manufactured or current-sale catalog.

catalogScope.zh: 已复核所列现行目录；本组37条，全部保留已接收145个身份和2251字段。现行未入库身份、非SKU/第三方关系和参数缺口分别见审阅记录；不声称全部完成。 2026-10-18 后续块补齐单臂手册手臂/腕部/ATI传感器图片表、关节限位及主机/用户/维修/扩展接口和托盘；Base 3.7-3.10 已入库。手册代际未映射到当前订单，数字与配置差异保留。 2026-10-18 传感器/附件块追加单臂电池、底座和头部的 13 张硬件表及热像/TX2/显示器/平板兼容配置/充电站，Base 第 17-18 章相关段落已录。共新增 134 行，不新增第三方制造产品身份；Android 和附加电池条目不套用历史硬件规格。
catalogScope.en: Reviewed listed current catalogs; 37 company records with all145 accepted identities and2251fields preserved globally. Current unregistered identities, non-SKU/third-party relationships and parameter gaps are separately reviewed; no exhaustive-completion claim. 2026-10-18 continuation adds single-arm arm/wrist/ATI image tables, joint limits, computer/user/service/expansion interfaces and tray; Base sections 3.7-3.10 are integrated. Handbook revisions are not mapped to current orders; numeric and configuration differences remain. 2026-10-18 sensor/accessory block adds 13 Single battery/base/head hardware tables plus thermal/TX2/display/tablet-compatible-configuration/docking fields and relevant Base chapters 17-18 sections. Adds 134 rows without third-party manufactured product identities; Android and additional-battery records do not inherit historical hardware specifications.

overview.zh: NEURA Robotics 2019 年成立于德国梅青根，当前产品范围明显超过 4NE1 单一人形本体。官网把 LARA、MAiRA、MAV、MiPA 和 4NE1 列为五条产品主线，并单列四项感知与交互附加模块。
overview.en: NEURA Robotics was founded in Metzingen, Germany, in 2019. Its current portfolio extends well beyond the 4NE1 humanoid: the official site lists LARA, MAiRA, MAV, MiPA, and 4NE1 as five main product lines and separately lists four sensing and interaction add-ons.

overview.zh: 除五条主要产品线及四类传感/示教附件外，本次确认4NE1 Mini Standard/Pro、NEURA Quadruped和Neuraverse。4NE1 V7明确区分20 kg手臂载荷与最高100 kg腿支撑配置；MiPA V5本体17自由度与预订页16自由度冲突，均不能混成一项额定指标。 MiPA官网六类具名附件单独登记为选件类别，未把宣传名称升级成有料号和额定参数的SKU。
overview.en: Beyond five main lines and four sensing/teaching add-ons, this review confirms 4NE1 Mini Standard/Pro, NEURA Quadruped and Neuraverse. 4NE1 V7 distinguishes 20 kg arm payload from up to 100 kg leg-supported configurations. MiPA V5 states 17 base DoF versus 16 on the reservation page; neither is silently normalized into one rating. Six named MiPA attachments registered as option categories, not upgraded from marketing names into part-coded/rated SKUs.

overview.zh: 2026-06-10公布最高14亿美元C轮规模，不等于全部资金已到账。公告所列超过10亿美元订单及战略部署管线也不等于已确认销售收入。Mini、Quadruped和MiPA预订条款仍描述2026计划，不能据此认定已交付。
overview.en: The 2026-06-10 Series C is stated as up to $1.4 billion, not proof that all funds arrived. Orders and strategic deployment pipeline above $1 billion are not recognized sales. Mini, Quadruped and MiPA reservation terms describe 2026 plans, not completed deliveries.

overview.zh: LARA 公开用户手册把机器人本体、控制柜和两代触屏示教器分别定义：2024 手册仅适用 LARA 3/5/8/10，控制柜为 IP31，V1/V2 在 2023 年 3 月交接。该工程资料补充了控制系统构成，不证明现行 LM 配置、独立配件销售或功能更新已交付。
overview.en: The LARA public user manual separates the robot, cabinet and two touchscreen pendant generations. Its 2024 scope covers LARA 3/5/8/10, specifies an IP31 cabinet, and places the V1/V2 transition in March 2023. This engineering evidence describes the control-system components, not current LM configurations, standalone sales or delivery of future functions.

Current unregistered identities, non-SKU/third-party relationships and parameter gaps are separately reviewed; no exhaustive-completion claim. 2026-10-18 continuation completes model-scoped diagram/interface records in LARA v3.2.1 sections 3.1-3.2 and chapter 6; no estimated load-chart points, separate V0.9/V1.0 pinouts, and no unconditional ratings for reserved channels or source conflicts. 2026-10-18 adds 199 technical rows from MAiRA V6 (2026-05-01) and MAV V6 (2026-06-10), scoped to MAiRA S/M/L and MAV 500/1500 with no inheritance to MAV+. Conditional payload, accuracy sign/conditions, options and release-status footnotes remain qualified; no whole-company completion claim.

overview.en: Hexagon introduced its robotics business and AEON industrial humanoid in 2025, linking robot hardware with its industrial measurement and digitalization stack.

overview.zh: 本组范围限定Hexagon Robotics的AEON人形本体与直接相关能力，不扩展为Hexagon全部测量、矿业或软件目录。公开内容包括自动换电、原地转向、工业巡检与操作；试点和训练设施建设属于经营进展。
overview.en: This group covers Hexagon Robotics AEON and directly related capabilities, not all Hexagon metrology, mining or software catalogs. Public material describes automatic battery swaps, turning, industrial inspection and manipulation; pilots/training facilities are business progress.

overview.zh: Hexagon 2026-04-30公告明确披露2025机器人业务成本2370万欧元，并计划2026投入5000万欧元（2025约2400万）。机器人业务暂不纳入2026-2030目标和EBITAC计算，并称将按季度披露，因此不能笼统写“无财务披露”。
overview.en: Hexagon on 2026-04-30 discloses 2025 robotics costs of EUR 23.7 million and plans EUR 50 million investment in 2026 versus about EUR 24 million in 2025. Robotics is excluded from 2026-2030 targets and EBITAC calculations, with quarterly disclosure planned; a blanket no-financial-disclosure claim is incorrect.

overview.en: Founded in 2012, Wandercraft developed the Atalante X self-balancing exoskeleton and expanded into the personal Eve device and Calvin-40 industrial humanoid.

overview.zh: Atalante X是监督康复设备，Eve是符合限定条件的个人外骨骼，Calvin-40是工业人形项目。Eve网页的使用者体重/身高限制不是机器人负载/尺寸；2026-09-17美国供应日相对本次核查仍在未来。
overview.en: Atalante X is supervised rehabilitation equipment, Eve a personal exoskeleton for eligible users, and Calvin-40 an industrial humanoid program. Eve user weight/height limits are not robot payload/dimensions; its 2026-09-17 U.S. availability date remains future at this review.

overview.en: Tesla describes Optimus as a general-purpose bipedal autonomous robot for unsafe, repetitive, or boring tasks. The official AI page does not publish a complete mechanical table for a current production edition.

overview.zh: Optimus以研发平台建档，当前官方AI页没有可供逐型号对比的完整生产版机械参数表。Q2 2026材料描述Fremont产线建设和预计年内稍晚生产，这些属于带时间条件的经营计划，不是验收后的产能或交付量。
overview.en: Optimus remains a development-platform record; the current AI page has no complete production-edition mechanical table. Q2 2026 material describes Fremont line construction and expected production later that year, which are time-qualified business plans rather than accepted capacity or deliveries.

overview.zh: 2026-07-22提交的Q2 10-Q为Tesla合并报表，不能视为Optimus单独财报。本次未找到Optimus独立收入、毛利和现金流；集团资本开支及研发同样不得全部分摊给该项目。
overview.en: The Q2 10-Q filed 2026-07-22 is Tesla consolidated reporting, not a standalone Optimus report. Separate Optimus revenue, gross margin and cash flow were not located; group capex/R&D cannot all be allocated to the program.

overview.en: Mentee Robotics was founded in 2022 and currently presents MenteeBot V3. The company emphasizes an AI-first stack from vision and language input to motion control.

overview.zh: MenteeBot硬件与AI First页面分别给出本体概览、自研部件、Sim2Real、NeRF建图及人类示范。演示视频明确区分遥操作与非遥操作，不能把全部手部演示统称自主。V3已有参数保留，但当前页的代际标识及后续版本仍需对应。
overview.en: MenteeBot hardware and AI First pages cover platform figures, in-house components, Sim2Real, NeRF mapping and human mentoring. Demonstrations distinguish teleoperated and non-teleoperated clips; all hand demonstrations cannot be called autonomous. Existing V3 values remain, with current-page and later-generation mapping still required.

overview.zh: Mobileye 2026年代理声明确认于2026-02-03收购Mentee全部股权，总对价约9亿美元。这是已完成并购而非融资轮；1月公告中的约6.12亿美元现金及2620万股为签约口径，可能受调整。
overview.en: Mobileye 2026 proxy confirms acquisition of all Mentee equity on 2026-02-03 for approximately $900 million. This is a completed acquisition, not a funding round. January-announced cash of about $612 million and 26.2 million shares were agreement terms subject to adjustments.

investmentView.zh: Mobileye 2026年代理声明确认于2026-02-03收购Mentee全部股权，总对价约9亿美元。这是已完成并购而非融资轮；1月公告中的约6.12亿美元现金及2620万股为签约口径，可能受调整。
investmentView.en: Mobileye 2026 proxy confirms acquisition of all Mentee equity on 2026-02-03 for approximately $900 million. This is a completed acquisition, not a funding round. January-announced cash of about $612 million and 26.2 million shares were agreement terms subject to adjustments.

overview.zh: Engineered Arts 2004 年成立，以 RoboThespian、Mesmer 和 Ameca 等交互机器人形成全尺寸与桌面产品。
overview.en: Founded in 2004, Engineered Arts built full-size and desktop interaction robots including RoboThespian, Mesmer, and Ameca.

overview.zh: 现售社交机器人包括Ameca和定制Mesmer全尺寸产品，以及Ameca Desktop、Ami和Azi桌面系列；Tritium包含UI、AI和OS层。MD3手册明确覆盖三种桌面外观，而Ameca Gen 2的62 kg整机质量不能转用于Mesmer；后者指南中的20-30 kg是拆装分件。 另逐页核查Gen2.6安装指南Rev2.0（2026-08-18），新增加LiDAR检查与版本表；指南不是完整型号工程规格表。
overview.en: The current social lineup includes full-size Ameca/custom Mesmer and Ameca Desktop, Ami and Azi. Tritium has UI, AI and OS layers. MD3 documentation explicitly covers the three desktop faces; Ameca Gen 2 complete mass of 62 kg cannot transfer to Mesmer, whose guide describes 20-30 kg disassembled components. Gen2.6 setup guide Rev2.0 (2026-08-18) reviewed page by page, including added LiDAR checks/revision table; it is not a complete engineering datasheet.

overview.zh: 英国ENGINEERED ARTS LIMITED（05265468）2024年报于2025-05-07公开提交，资产负债表列现金255.45万英镑、净资产541.58万英镑。公司未提交损益表，审计意见对期初存货估值保留；不能把留存损益当作年度净利。美国直接母公司为Engineered Arts Holding Company Inc，英国报表不是母公司合并财报。
overview.en: ENGINEERED ARTS LIMITED (05265468) 2024 accounts filed 2025-05-07 show GBP 2.554 million cash and GBP 5.416 million net assets. No P&L was filed and the audit is qualified over opening-inventory valuation; retained P&L reserves are not annual profit. The direct U.S. parent is Engineered Arts Holding Company Inc; these UK accounts are not parent consolidated statements.

overview.zh: Clone Robotics 2021 年成立，核心路线是用 Myofiber 人工肌肉、腱和仿生骨架构建手与全身人形。
overview.en: Clone Robotics was founded in 2021 around Myofiber artificial muscles, tendons, and biomimetic skeletons for hands and full-body humanoids.

overview.zh: Clone Hand、Clone Alpha、Neoclone与Myofiber人工肌肉分开记录。小于50 ms、空载收缩超过30%及3 g肌纤维至少产生1 kg力是肌肉设计条件，不是整手或整机的额定响应、负载与质量；279台限量预订也不是交付数量。
overview.en: Clone Hand, Clone Alpha, Neoclone and Myofiber artificial muscle are separate. Under 50 ms, over 30% unloaded contraction and at least 1 kg-force from a 3 g fiber are muscle design criteria, not complete-hand/robot response, payload or mass ratings. A 279-unit reservation edition is not a delivery count.

overview.zh: ANYbotics 2016 年从 ETH Zurich 衍生成立，聚焦工业自主四足巡检。ANYmal 与 ANYmal X 有独立规格文件。
overview.en: ANYbotics spun out of ETH Zurich in 2016 and focuses on autonomous industrial quadruped inspection. ANYmal and ANYmal X have separate specification documents.

overview.zh: ANYmal和防爆ANYmal X保留独立版本；本次补充2022 D代手册的地形、传感器、载荷接口及巡检载荷全部可读技术行。历史D代手册不视为当前所有ANYmal配置的统一规格，也不把普通巡检载荷认证转给X。
overview.en: ANYmal and explosion-protected ANYmal X remain separate. This pass adds readable terrain, sensor, payload-interface and inspection-payload technical rows from the 2022 generation-D manual. The historical manual is not a universal current specification, and ordinary payload certification does not transfer to X.

title.zh: 发布气体泄漏及存在检测方案
title.en: Gas Leak and Presence Detection offering launched

detail.zh: 官方公告为2025年6月；页头18日与正文17日不同，时间线保留到月。方案集成声学成像与气体浓度检测，不把第三方传感器列作自产。
detail.en: Official announcement is from June2025; header18th and body17th disagree, so month precision is retained. Integrates acoustic imaging and gas-concentration detection without claiming third-party sensors as in-house products.

round.zh: 追加融资（原公告未在此重标轮次）

overview.zh: Diligent Robotics 于 2017 年在奥斯汀成立，核心产品 Moxi 是面向医护协作的移动操作机器人。公司把产品定位在减少非临床往返任务，而不是替代临床判断。
overview.en: Diligent Robotics was founded in Austin in 2017. Its core product, Moxi, is a mobile manipulator for healthcare collaboration, intended to reduce non-clinical transport rather than replace clinical judgment.

overview.zh: Moxi用于非直接护理的医院物流。2026-08-17正式推出的Moxi 2.0公告指定NVIDIA A2000，而2025预告为IGX Thor；本次保留两版来源并禁止混成同一硬件配置。9小时单次运行与含补电18小时/日属于不同续航口径。
overview.en: Moxi serves non-direct-care hospital logistics. The 2026-08-17 Moxi 2.0 rollout specifies NVIDIA A2000 while the 2025 preview specified IGX Thor; both sources are retained without combining them into one configuration. Nine hours per charge and eighteen hours per day with charging are different runtime scopes.

overview.zh: 2026年推出公告明确Diligent为Serve Robotics公司。收购不归融资轮；如使用Serve上市财报，必须区分集团数据、收购会计与Diligent/Moxi单独经营结果，本次没有虚构Moxi收入。
overview.en: The 2026 rollout identifies Diligent as a Serve Robotics company. Acquisition is not a funding round; Serve public filings must distinguish group data, acquisition accounting and Diligent/Moxi standalone results. No Moxi revenue is invented here.

detail.en: Announcement specifies A2000 onboard compute, expanded sensing and modular design for the 2026 rollout version.

detail.en: The 2026-08-17 release identifies Diligent as a Serve Robotics company; this entry does not infer the exact closing day.

overview.zh: Collaborative Robotics 于 2022 年成立并使用 Cobot 品牌，由前 Amazon Robotics 负责人 Brad Porter 创办。
overview.en: Collaborative Robotics was founded in 2022 under the Cobot brand by former Amazon Robotics leader Brad Porter.

overview.zh: Cobot的Proxie Gen 2、Vista机群软件和ScoutMap设施评估分别建档。FlexGrasp、Glide360、ScoutSense、TaskTouch和CushionRide是产品功能名称，不拆成无独立订货证据的硬件SKU。小时成本示例需保留班次假设，不能当作购置价格。
overview.en: Cobot Proxie Gen 2, Vista fleet software and ScoutMap facility assessment remain separate. FlexGrasp, Glide360, ScoutSense, TaskTouch and CushionRide are feature names, not independent hardware SKUs without ordering evidence. Hourly cost examples retain shift assumptions and are not purchase prices.

overview.zh: 2024年4月官方说明回顾1000万美元种子轮、3000万美元A轮和1亿美元B轮，B轮由General Catalyst领投。历史4000万美元种子加A轮合计不应与两个分项重复相加；未披露的收入与盈利不推算。
overview.en: The April 2024 company article recounts a $10 million seed, $30 million Series A and $100 million Series B led by General Catalyst. The prior $40 million seed-plus-A total must not be added again to its components; undisclosed revenue and profitability are not estimated.

overview.zh: 历史研发路线：2022-06 公司文章关注人与移动机器人的共同工作空间；2024-04 回顾首台机器人形成、多台复制和物流现场测试准备，2024-11 才公开提及 Proxie 展示。研发样机、测试准备、展示和当前 Gen 2 属于不同阶段，不把创始人过往 Amazon 团队规模计入 Cobot。来源：https://www.co.bot/news/the-starting-point；https://www.co.bot/news/robots-come-to-life；https://www.co.bot/news/the-community-you-build
overview.en: Historical development: the 2022-06 article focuses on shared human/mobile-robot workspaces; the 2024-04 retrospective recounts the first robot, replication and field-test readiness, while the 2024-11 article discusses the Proxie reveal. Prototype development, test readiness, reveal and current Gen 2 are distinct stages; the founder's former Amazon team size is not Cobot headcount. Sources: https://www.co.bot/news/the-starting-point; https://www.co.bot/news/robots-come-to-life; https://www.co.bot/news/the-community-you-build

overview.zh: 2024-12 开发案例描述 Isaac Sim 数字孪生、ROS 2/Isaac ROS、2 块 Orin 分别处理感知导航和人机交互，以及 Jetson Nano 的底层运动/电源管理。Orin/Nano 是 NVIDIA 集成元件，非 Cobot 自制产品；本段不向当前 Gen 2 继承配置。文中约 30 台、超过 5000 h、16000 辆推车及超过 621 mi（1000 km）是当时公司/合作方披露的累计部署口径，非独立认证、单台寿命或当前数量。来源：https://www.co.bot/news/cobot-develops-ai-driven-collaborative-robots-with-nvidia-isaac
overview.en: The 2024-12 development case describes Isaac Sim digital twins, ROS 2/Isaac ROS, 2 Orin modules for perception/navigation and human interaction, and Jetson Nano for low-level motion/power management. Orin/Nano are integrated NVIDIA components, not Cobot-manufactured products; configurations are not inherited by current Gen 2. Approximately 30 robots, over 5000 h, 16000 carts and over 621 mi (1000 km) are then-reported company/partner aggregate deployment figures, not independent certification, single-unit life or current fleet counts. Source: https://www.co.bot/news/cobot-develops-ai-driven-collaborative-robots-with-nvidia-isaac

detail.zh: 公司披露1亿美元B轮，由General Catalyst领投。
detail.en: Company disclosed a $100 million Series B led by General Catalyst.

title.zh: 公开早期机器人研发方向

detail.zh: Brad Porter 在当月公司文章中提出开发可与人共处的灵活移动机器人，面向物流、制造和医疗等场景；这是当时研发愿景，不是法人注册日或产品上市证明。
detail.en: Brad Porter's company article sets out a flexible mobile robot working alongside people in logistics, manufacturing and healthcare; a development vision at that time, not a legal incorporation date or product-launch proof.

title.zh: 首台机器人形成的回顾记录
title.en: Retrospective account of the first robot

detail.zh: 2024-04 文章回顾“去年十一月”已有可交互的首台机器人，按该发布时间推定为 2023-11；不把这一研发节点视作公开发布或 Gen 2 交付。
detail.en: The 2024-04 article recalls having the first interactive robot in the previous November, yielding 2023-11 from the publication context; this development milestone is not a public launch or Gen 2 delivery.

title.zh: 准备进入物流现场测试

detail.zh: 2024-04 回顾称至当年一月已制成多台，准备与未具名全球物流伙伴开展大型工业推车交叉转运测试；准备测试不等于已完成验收或规模交付。
detail.en: The 2024-04 retrospective says multiple units were ready by January of that year for field testing of large industrial-cart movements with an unnamed global logistics partner; readiness is not completed acceptance or scaled delivery.

title.zh: 安排投资者机器人演示

detail.zh: 按 2024-04 公司回顾语境，向投资者演示的安排日期记为 2024-01-30，机器人设计当时仍未公开；该日期不是商业发布日或额定能力验证日。
detail.en: From the 2024-04 company retrospective context, the scheduled investor demonstration is dated 2024-01-30 while the robot design remained undisclosed; not a commercial launch or a rated-performance validation date.

title.zh: Proxie 公开展示及客户访谈

detail.zh: 当月公司文章明确提及 Proxie 公开展示，并描述与 Maersk、Moderna、Owens & Minor 和 Tampa General Hospital 联系制作客户访谈；不从访谈推定各方订单量、验收结果或 Gen 2 部署。
detail.en: The company article identifies the Proxie reveal and describes customer-interview participation involving Maersk, Moderna, Owens & Minor and Tampa General Hospital; no inference of order volumes, acceptance outcomes or Gen 2 deployments.

title.zh: 披露仿真优先的开发流程

detail.zh: NVIDIA 与 Cobot 作者联合署名文章描述以客户交叉转运场地和测试实验室数字孪生验证软件，再使用 Isaac ROS 部署到 Jetson。属于当时 Proxie 的开发案例，不是 Gen 2 当前配置证明。
detail.en: An article co-authored by NVIDIA and Cobot describes validating software in digital twins of a customer cross-dock and test lab, then deploying through Isaac ROS to Jetson. A historical Proxie development case, not proof of the current Gen 2 configuration.

investors.zh: General Catalyst (lead); Bison Ventures; Industry Ventures; Lux Capital; existing investors
investors.en: General Catalyst (lead); Bison Ventures; Industry Ventures; Lux Capital; existing investors

investmentView.zh: 2024年4月官方说明回顾1000万美元种子轮、3000万美元A轮和1亿美元B轮，B轮由General Catalyst领投。历史4000万美元种子加A轮合计不应与两个分项重复相加；未披露的收入与盈利不推算。
investmentView.en: The April 2024 company article recounts a $10 million seed, $30 million Series A and $100 million Series B led by General Catalyst. The prior $40 million seed-plus-A total must not be added again to its components; undisclosed revenue and profitability are not estimated.

type.zh: 高载荷全尺寸研究型人形机器人

integration.zh: 以 Ubuntu LTS、Linux RT Preempt、ROS、OROCOS、ros_control、MoveIt、Gazebo 与 URDF 为公开软件基础，并提供以太网、Wi-Fi 和外部 EtherCAT 主站接入。
integration.en: Uses Ubuntu LTS, Linux RT Preempt, ROS, OROCOS, ros_control, MoveIt, Gazebo, and URDF as its published software foundation, with Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and external EtherCAT-master connectivity.

verification.zh: 交付前锁定定制关节、传感器、计算机、软件版本、电池、相机、夹爪、急停和维护方案；在有防跌倒和安全隔离的实验环境中验收。

overview.zh: TALOS 是 PAL Robotics 面向全身控制、步行和双臂操作研究的全尺寸平台，官方数据表给出 32 自由度、175 cm 高度和 95 kg 质量。
overview.en: TALOS is PAL Robotics' full-size platform for whole-body control, walking, and bimanual-manipulation research; its official datasheet publishes 32 DoF, 175 cm height, and 95 kg mass.

overview.zh: 数据表同时覆盖四个六轴力/矩传感器、除头/腕/夹爪外的全关节扭矩反馈、双 Intel Core i7 和 ROS/OROCOS 软件栈。平台标注为可定制，因此采购配置必须以订单和当前手册为准。
overview.en: The datasheet also covers four six-axis force/torque sensors, torque feedback on all joints except head/wrists/grippers, dual Intel Core i7 computers, and a ROS/OROCOS software stack. Because the platform is described as customizable, the purchased configuration must follow the order and current manuals.

overview.zh: LARA 3 是当前 LARA 系列的具名型号，官方页面明确给出 3 kg 负载、590 mm 臂展和 18 kg 本体质量。
overview.en: LARA 3 is a named current LARA model. The official page states 3 kg payload, 590 mm reach, and 18 kg robot mass.

overview.zh: IP、精度、安全和接口在页面上按系列披露，报价时必须确认具体型号与配置是否全部适用。
overview.en: IP, accuracy, safety, and interfaces are published at family level; applicability to the quoted model and configuration must be confirmed.

overview.zh: 2024 用户手册补充了速度条件、底座与接口表；所有新增旧版数值仅按该手册保存，不替代现行订货配置。控制柜与示教器另列配套部件。
overview.en: The 2024 user manual adds speed conditions, base dimensions and interface tables. New legacy values are manual-scoped, not replacements for current order configurations; cabinet and pendants are separate system components.

overview.zh: V6 / 2026-06-01 数据表补充逐轴速度、配套系统与安装图。旧行完整保留；相同值复用既有记录。网页图片 alt 的 LM 名称与下拉菜单及下载表列名不同，新增项仅作同一区块对应的来源附录，不证明硬件等同；通用法兰表与大负载型号图的孔数差异仍待厂商确认。
overview.en: The V6 / 2026-06-01 datasheet adds per-axis speeds, associated system details and mounting drawings. Old rows remain intact; matching values reuse existing records. Web image-alt LM names differ from selector and downloaded-table columns; additions are same-panel source appendices, not proof of hardware equivalence. The generic flange table versus large-model drawing hole-count discrepancy still requires manufacturer confirmation.

applications.zh: 装配、上下料、焊接、打磨、点胶、检测和码垛
applications.en: Assembly, machine tending, welding, finishing, dispensing, inspection, and palletizing

integration.zh: 通过标准化法兰、EtherCAT、IO-Link、EtherNet/IP、PROFINET、Modbus TCP/RTU、RS-485 和 GPIO 接入工作站。
integration.en: Integrates into workcells through standardized flanges, EtherCAT, IO-Link, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/RTU, RS-485, and GPIO.

verification.zh: 确认具体控制器、IP54/IP66 版本、安装姿态、负载重心、速度、精度、安全等级、力矩传感器选件和现场总线。
verification.en: Confirm controller, IP54/IP66 edition, mounting pose, payload center of gravity, speed, accuracy, safety level, force-torque option, and fieldbus.

overview.zh: LARA 5 是当前 LARA 系列的具名型号，官方页面明确给出 5 kg 负载、800 mm 臂展和 26 kg 本体质量。
overview.en: LARA 5 is a named current LARA model. The official page states 5 kg payload, 800 mm reach, and 26 kg robot mass.

overview.zh: IP、精度、安全和接口在页面上按系列披露，报价时必须确认具体型号与配置是否全部适用。
overview.en: IP, accuracy, safety, and interfaces are published at family level; applicability to the quoted model and configuration must be confirmed.

overview.zh: 2024 用户手册补充了速度条件、底座与接口表；所有新增旧版数值仅按该手册保存，不替代现行订货配置。控制柜与示教器另列配套部件。
overview.en: The 2024 user manual adds speed conditions, base dimensions and interface tables. New legacy values are manual-scoped, not replacements for current order configurations; cabinet and pendants are separate system components.

overview.zh: V6 / 2026-06-01 数据表补充逐轴速度、配套系统与安装图。旧行完整保留；相同值复用既有记录。网页图片 alt 的 LM 名称与下拉菜单及下载表列名不同，新增项仅作同一区块对应的来源附录，不证明硬件等同；通用法兰表与大负载型号图的孔数差异仍待厂商确认。
overview.en: The V6 / 2026-06-01 datasheet adds per-axis speeds, associated system details and mounting drawings. Old rows remain intact; matching values reuse existing records. Web image-alt LM names differ from selector and downloaded-table columns; additions are same-panel source appendices, not proof of hardware equivalence. The generic flange table versus large-model drawing hole-count discrepancy still requires manufacturer confirmation.

applications.zh: 装配、上下料、焊接、打磨、点胶、检测和码垛
applications.en: Assembly, machine tending, welding, finishing, dispensing, inspection, and palletizing

integration.zh: 通过标准化法兰、EtherCAT、IO-Link、EtherNet/IP、PROFINET、Modbus TCP/RTU、RS-485 和 GPIO 接入工作站。
integration.en: Integrates into workcells through standardized flanges, EtherCAT, IO-Link, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/RTU, RS-485, and GPIO.

verification.zh: 确认具体控制器、IP54/IP66 版本、安装姿态、负载重心、速度、精度、安全等级、力矩传感器选件和现场总线。
verification.en: Confirm controller, IP54/IP66 edition, mounting pose, payload center of gravity, speed, accuracy, safety level, force-torque option, and fieldbus.

overview.zh: LARA 8 是当前 LARA 系列的具名型号，官方页面明确给出 8 kg 负载、1300 mm 臂展和 48 kg 本体质量。
overview.en: LARA 8 is a named current LARA model. The official page states 8 kg payload, 1300 mm reach, and 48 kg robot mass.

overview.zh: IP、精度、安全和接口在页面上按系列披露，报价时必须确认具体型号与配置是否全部适用。
overview.en: IP, accuracy, safety, and interfaces are published at family level; applicability to the quoted model and configuration must be confirmed.

overview.zh: 2024 用户手册补充了速度条件、底座与接口表；所有新增旧版数值仅按该手册保存，不替代现行订货配置。控制柜与示教器另列配套部件。
overview.en: The 2024 user manual adds speed conditions, base dimensions and interface tables. New legacy values are manual-scoped, not replacements for current order configurations; cabinet and pendants are separate system components.

overview.zh: V6 / 2026-06-01 数据表补充逐轴速度、配套系统与安装图。旧行完整保留；相同值复用既有记录。网页图片 alt 的 LM 名称与下拉菜单及下载表列名不同，新增项仅作同一区块对应的来源附录，不证明硬件等同；通用法兰表与大负载型号图的孔数差异仍待厂商确认。
overview.en: The V6 / 2026-06-01 datasheet adds per-axis speeds, associated system details and mounting drawings. Old rows remain intact; matching values reuse existing records. Web image-alt LM names differ from selector and downloaded-table columns; additions are same-panel source appendices, not proof of hardware equivalence. The generic flange table versus large-model drawing hole-count discrepancy still requires manufacturer confirmation.

applications.zh: 装配、上下料、焊接、打磨、点胶、检测和码垛
applications.en: Assembly, machine tending, welding, finishing, dispensing, inspection, and palletizing

integration.zh: 通过标准化法兰、EtherCAT、IO-Link、EtherNet/IP、PROFINET、Modbus TCP/RTU、RS-485 和 GPIO 接入工作站。
integration.en: Integrates into workcells through standardized flanges, EtherCAT, IO-Link, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/RTU, RS-485, and GPIO.

verification.zh: 确认具体控制器、IP54/IP66 版本、安装姿态、负载重心、速度、精度、安全等级、力矩传感器选件和现场总线。
verification.en: Confirm controller, IP54/IP66 edition, mounting pose, payload center of gravity, speed, accuracy, safety level, force-torque option, and fieldbus.

overview.zh: LARA 10 是当前 LARA 系列的具名型号，官方页面明确给出 10 kg 负载、1000 mm 臂展和 45 kg 本体质量。
overview.en: LARA 10 is a named current LARA model. The official page states 10 kg payload, 1000 mm reach, and 45 kg robot mass.

overview.zh: IP、精度、安全和接口在页面上按系列披露，报价时必须确认具体型号与配置是否全部适用。
overview.en: IP, accuracy, safety, and interfaces are published at family level; applicability to the quoted model and configuration must be confirmed.

overview.zh: 2024 用户手册补充了速度条件、底座与接口表；所有新增旧版数值仅按该手册保存，不替代现行订货配置。控制柜与示教器另列配套部件。
overview.en: The 2024 user manual adds speed conditions, base dimensions and interface tables. New legacy values are manual-scoped, not replacements for current order configurations; cabinet and pendants are separate system components.

overview.zh: V6 / 2026-06-01 数据表补充逐轴速度、配套系统与安装图。旧行完整保留；相同值复用既有记录。网页图片 alt 的 LM 名称与下拉菜单及下载表列名不同，新增项仅作同一区块对应的来源附录，不证明硬件等同；通用法兰表与大负载型号图的孔数差异仍待厂商确认。
overview.en: The V6 / 2026-06-01 datasheet adds per-axis speeds, associated system details and mounting drawings. Old rows remain intact; matching values reuse existing records. Web image-alt LM names differ from selector and downloaded-table columns; additions are same-panel source appendices, not proof of hardware equivalence. The generic flange table versus large-model drawing hole-count discrepancy still requires manufacturer confirmation.

applications.zh: 装配、上下料、焊接、打磨、点胶、检测和码垛
applications.en: Assembly, machine tending, welding, finishing, dispensing, inspection, and palletizing

overview.zh: LARA LM 15 是当前 LARA 系列的具名型号，官方页面明确给出 15 kg 负载、1600 mm 臂展和 67 kg 本体质量。
overview.en: LARA LM 15 is a named current LARA model. The official page states 15 kg payload, 1600 mm reach, and 67 kg robot mass.

overview.zh: IP、精度、安全和接口在页面上按系列披露，报价时必须确认具体型号与配置是否全部适用。
overview.en: IP, accuracy, safety, and interfaces are published at family level; applicability to the quoted model and configuration must be confirmed.

overview.zh: V6 / 2026-06-01 数据表补充逐轴速度、配套系统与安装图。旧行完整保留；相同值复用既有记录。网页图片 alt 的 LM 名称与下拉菜单及下载表列名不同，新增项仅作同一区块对应的来源附录，不证明硬件等同；通用法兰表与大负载型号图的孔数差异仍待厂商确认。
overview.en: The V6 / 2026-06-01 datasheet adds per-axis speeds, associated system details and mounting drawings. Old rows remain intact; matching values reuse existing records. Web image-alt LM names differ from selector and downloaded-table columns; additions are same-panel source appendices, not proof of hardware equivalence. The generic flange table versus large-model drawing hole-count discrepancy still requires manufacturer confirmation.

applications.zh: 装配、上下料、焊接、打磨、点胶、检测和码垛
applications.en: Assembly, machine tending, welding, finishing, dispensing, inspection, and palletizing

overview.zh: LARA LM 20 是当前 LARA 系列的具名型号，官方页面明确给出 20 kg 负载、1800 mm 臂展和 98 kg 本体质量。
overview.en: LARA LM 20 is a named current LARA model. The official page states 20 kg payload, 1800 mm reach, and 98 kg robot mass.

overview.zh: IP、精度、安全和接口在页面上按系列披露，报价时必须确认具体型号与配置是否全部适用。
overview.en: IP, accuracy, safety, and interfaces are published at family level; applicability to the quoted model and configuration must be confirmed.

overview.zh: V6 / 2026-06-01 数据表补充逐轴速度、配套系统与安装图。旧行完整保留；相同值复用既有记录。网页图片 alt 的 LM 名称与下拉菜单及下载表列名不同，新增项仅作同一区块对应的来源附录，不证明硬件等同；通用法兰表与大负载型号图的孔数差异仍待厂商确认。
overview.en: The V6 / 2026-06-01 datasheet adds per-axis speeds, associated system details and mounting drawings. Old rows remain intact; matching values reuse existing records. Web image-alt LM names differ from selector and downloaded-table columns; additions are same-panel source appendices, not proof of hardware equivalence. The generic flange table versus large-model drawing hole-count discrepancy still requires manufacturer confirmation.

overview.zh: V6 / 2026-06-01 数据表补充逐轴速度、配套系统与安装图。旧行完整保留；相同值复用既有记录。网页图片 alt 的 LM 名称与下拉菜单及下载表列名不同，新增项仅作同一区块对应的来源附录，不证明硬件等同；通用法兰表与大负载型号图的孔数差异仍待厂商确认。
overview.en: The V6 / 2026-06-01 datasheet adds per-axis speeds, associated system details and mounting drawings. Old rows remain intact; matching values reuse existing records. Web image-alt LM names differ from selector and downloaded-table columns; additions are same-panel source appendices, not proof of hardware equivalence. The generic flange table versus large-model drawing hole-count discrepancy still requires manufacturer confirmation.

overview.zh: LARA LM 30 是当前 LARA 系列的具名型号，官方页面明确给出 30 kg 负载、1300 mm 臂展和 98 kg 本体质量。
overview.en: LARA LM 30 is a named current LARA model. The official page states 30 kg payload, 1300 mm reach, and 98 kg robot mass.

overview.zh: IP、精度、安全和接口在页面上按系列披露，报价时必须确认具体型号与配置是否全部适用。
overview.en: IP, accuracy, safety, and interfaces are published at family level; applicability to the quoted model and configuration must be confirmed.

overview.zh: V6 / 2026-06-01 数据表补充逐轴速度、配套系统与安装图。旧行完整保留；相同值复用既有记录。网页图片 alt 的 LM 名称与下拉菜单及下载表列名不同，新增项仅作同一区块对应的来源附录，不证明硬件等同；通用法兰表与大负载型号图的孔数差异仍待厂商确认。
overview.en: The V6 / 2026-06-01 datasheet adds per-axis speeds, associated system details and mounting drawings. Old rows remain intact; matching values reuse existing records. Web image-alt LM names differ from selector and downloaded-table columns; additions are same-panel source appendices, not proof of hardware equivalence. The generic flange table versus large-model drawing hole-count discrepancy still requires manufacturer confirmation.

overview.zh: Spot 当前页面提供基础机器人、电池和载荷安装区块。运行时间会随载荷和环境变化；14 kg 是当前营销页的载荷安装质量值。
overview.en: The current Spot page publishes base-robot, battery, and payload-mounting blocks. Runtime varies with payload and environment; 14 kg is the current marketing-page payload-mount mass.

overview.zh: 官网公制长度显示为 110 mm，但同一行的 43.3 in 对应约 1,100 mm；本仓保留纠错说明，而不是把明显排版错误当作机器人长度。
overview.en: The official metric length is displayed as 110 mm while the same line states 43.3 in, or about 1,100 mm; this repository records the correction explicitly rather than treating the obvious display typo as robot length.

applications.zh: 工业巡检、远程响应、数字孪生、科研和危险环境数据采集
applications.en: Industrial inspection, remote response, digital twins, research, and hazardous-environment data capture

type.zh: 移动式箱件卸载与仓储处理机器人

integration.zh: 使用 7 轴机械臂、视觉、带感知气动夹具、控制台和无线输送机通信完成卸载。
integration.en: Uses a seven-axis arm, vision, a sensing pneumatic gripper, console, and wireless conveyor communication for unloading.

verification.zh: 用现场箱型、破损程度、拖车、输送机、温度、班次与人员配置复核 600-800 箱/小时和 16 小时上限。
verification.en: Revalidate the 600-800 cases/hour and up-to-16-hour figures with site-specific cases, damage, trailers, conveyors, temperature, shifts, and staffing.
